description: List racing market movers in races still to run: runners whose win price moved most since it opened (firming or drifting), with the opening price and bookmaker against the median and best current price. Australian races by default. Needs Pro or the free Pro trial; 10 credits a call.

code.description: thoroughbred, harness or greyhound. Leave it out for all three.

direction.description: firming (price shortening), drifting (lengthening) or any. Default any.

hours_ahead.description: Races starting within this many hours. Default 3, at most 24.

min_change_pct.description: Smallest move to list, in percent of the opening price. Default 10.

name: racing_movers
title: Racing market movers
